description: This Java class 'WidgetUtil' provides a utility method to set appropriate flags for PendingIntent objects, ensuring compatibility across different Android API levels, particularly handling API-specific requirements for PendingIntent flags.

classes.name: WidgetUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling PendingIntent flags with Android API level compatibility.

methods.name: pendingIntentFlagCompat
methods.description: Adjusts the flags for PendingIntent based on the Android API level to ensure compatibility, adding FLAG_IMMUTABLE for API 34+ and FLAG_MUTABLE for API 31+.
